description: AI image generation / text to image: one image from a text prompt with Google Imagen 4, returned as base64 image bytes with its MIME type. Use it for illustrations, thumbnails, product mockups and social images. Input: prompt; optional aspect_ratio. $0.50 per call. Returns: prompt, aspect_ratio, image_base64, mime_type, model.

language.description: Optional BCP-47 language tag (en, ja, ko, pt-BR): the human-readable strings of the result (notes, details, reasons) are translated into this language; data, codes, numbers and URLs are untouched. Default: as produced.

name: hubvibe_image_generate
title: Generate an image
